name: Level Ladder
about: A talking-head roadmap kit: speaker at a desk with five poker chips and a chess knight marking the current level; neon-violet level orbs held between two glowing hands (a coin flip between levels); white-grid UI boards with lime stickers; paper posters (reveal with a face cut-out, an orbit of tool icons, words that shatter); photo inserts with hand-drawn labels and arrows; black cards with lime type; two-tier captions. Learned from reference r2, built with ishaan-motion.

motion.engine: ishaan-motion canvas engine (kits/motion/core.js): AE ramps, closed-form springs, log-space slams, velocity smear
